mentions.name: blastQR
mentions.description: A FOSS cross-platform app and CLI tool that transfers files truly offline using animated QR code sequences, currently reaching peak transfer speeds of 1.4MB/s. Suited for large-screen broadcasts so people can receive information during internet blackouts, quick private offline sharing of pictures and small files, air-gapped systems, and use on airplanes.
mentions.problem: Enables file sharing when there is no internet connection, such as during digital blackouts, government internet cutoffs, on air-gapped systems, or in airplanes.
mentions.audience: personal-use sharing of photos and small files in daily life, people receiving broadcasts during internet blackouts, and operators of air-gapped systems
mentions.source_excerpt: Truly offline file transfers through animated QR code sequences. It's one of the projects I've been working on for the past 2 years: blastQR.
